title: Goal Translation Canvas and Interteam Onramp
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: create a repeatable 'Goal Translation Canvas' and an Interteam Onramp process that reliably converts company-level OKRs into clearly scoped, timeboxed initiatives owned by teams across Eng/Design/Console/Optimize. This artifact will reduce ambiguity during quarterly planning, shrink handoff cycles, and provide a single source of truth for initiative boundaries, acceptance criteria, and telemetry hooks.

Why: current planning signals are noisy: teams interpret high-level OKRs inconsistently, scope creeps during first two sprints, and cross-team dependencies surface late. We need a lightweight template + guided process so PMs and Eng leads can align quickly and hand off a ship-ready initiative to sprint planning with minimal rework.

Outcomes: a documented canvas stored in Confluence, Linear templates that produce consistent tickets (title/labels/deps), a 60–90 minute interteam workshop runbook, and an onboarding checklist for team leads plus metrics to measure translation quality (rework rate, dependency latency, predictability score).
acceptance_criteria: Canonical Goal Translation Canvas published in Confluence with examples (Platform, Dedicated, Private)
Linear ticket template created and pushed to product-management templates with prefilled fields and labels
3 pilot teams (Serving Runtime, Console, Dedicated) complete the onramp workshop and score >= 4/5 on clarity survey
Measured reduction in first-sprint scope changes by at least 30% for pilot initiatives within 1 quarter
Telemetry hooks (OKR id, initiative id) defined and added to rollout dashboards
tasks: Draft canvas v0 with sections: Objective, Success Metrics, Constraints, Non-goals, Stakeholders, Dependencies, Acceptance Tests, Rollout Plan, Risk Register
Review canvas with PM guild and adjust fields for model-serving specifics (latency/cost/eval signals)
Add Linear template and automation to pre-populate dependencies and labels
Design 60-minute interactive workshop and create facilitator guide
Pilot with Serving Runtime, Console, Dedicated; collect feedback and iterate
Instrument rollout dashboard and the 'translation quality' metric pipeline
decisions: Keep canvas intentionally short (max 1 page) to reduce friction
Add explicit 'non-goals' section to limit scope creep
Use Linear templates + labels for discoverability instead of building new tooling
Telemetry will be a minimal OKR-id + initiative-id tag in rollout events; more detailed instrumentation deferred to Optimize team
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Teams skip the onramp workshop -> Mitigation: require completion for initiatives tagged company-okr in Linear during pilot
Risk: Template too opinionated for platform teams -> Mitigation: include optional fields and a 'platform considerations' annex
Risk: Telemetry adoption lags -> Mitigation: ship lightweight event tags first and follow up with instrumentation office hours
